newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium futures firm on yen's weakness.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium futures firm on yen's weakness.

text.p: Tokyo yen-based aluminium futures finished mostly higher in thin trade, helped by the dollar's strong advance against the yen, traders said on Friday.
"Trade was very thin as we're in the middle of the Obon holidays," said a trader. "We've seen some selling around 200 yen (per kg), which was met by small lot buying."
The June contract added 0.8 yen to close at 199.3 per kg, while April climbed 1.4 to 200.4 yen. Others were between 0.7 yen weaker to 3.3 yen higher.
Estimated volume was a thin 942 lots.
The dollar was trading above 118 yen in Asia on Friday, up from above 116 yen a day earlier.
In London overnight, three month aluminium finished up $5 at $1,700 per tonne, with nearby tightness offsetting another stock increase.
